evals.prompt: /research what's new with the Bun JavaScript runtime --quick
evals.expected_output: Precondition: Parallel Search is connected (a claude.ai or Cowork connector, or a Claude Code server added with claude mcp add) and answers. A NEWS report at quick depth: the skill looks for Parallel Search and Keenable with ToolSearch, makes one test call to Parallel's web_search before anything else, runs the script from the skill folder, dispatches 6 subagents in one message through the Agent tool with Parallel's tools under the exact names ToolSearch returned, and the stats footer says the search backend was Parallel Search.
expectations: ToolSearch is run for Parallel Search ('parallel web_search') and for Keenable ('keenable search_web_pages') before any subagent is dispatched

One test call to Parallel's web_search, under the full mcp__<server>__web_search name ToolSearch returned and with the run's session_id, is made before any subagent is dispatched, and Keenable is not tested once Parallel Search answers
The script is run from the skill's own folder (the resolved ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/research.py) with --quick, never through a ~/.claude/skills/research or .claude/skills/research path
Exactly 6 subagents (C1-C3 and O1-O3) are dispatched in a single message through the Agent tool, and no Task or TaskOutput tool is called

Every subagent prompt names Parallel's web_search and web_fetch with the same full mcp__ prefix ToolSearch returned, tells the agent to pass objective and search_queries (site: operators kept in the queries) and the same session_id the test call used on every call, and carries the switch rule (at most 2-3 calls in flight, one retry after about 5 seconds on a per-second rate limit, a move to the next backend after a second rate-limit reply, an out-of-credits reply, an hourly cap or a second error, and a note saying so)
QUERY_TYPE is NEWS, and the subagents are told to check each result's date against DATE_FROM, because Parallel Search has no date filter
The report has the community section, the official section, and a cross-reference table with 3-5 rows marked Aligned, Divergent, or Gap
The stats footer has a line 'Search backend: Parallel Search (...)', with any subagent that switched backends named in its fallback part
The report ends with the invitation offering follow-ups or to save the report as a file (Markdown, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, web page), with no offer to write a prompt, and then waits for the user

A research brief, with its period and the answers the run assumed (nobody can answer in an eval run), is shown before any ToolSearch, script run or subagent, and the script runs with --days for that period
